{"id":2063664126,"question_id":2793,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 week, 5 days","timestamp":1783759321,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"82 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/2063664126/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Count the Number of Complete Components","memory":"146.9 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    unordered_map<int , vector<int>>adj;\n\n    void DFS(int src , int component_id , vector<int>&components)\n    {\n        components[src] = component_id;\n\n        for(auto nbr : adj[src])\n        {\n            if(components[nbr] == -1) DFS(nbr , component_id , components);\n        }\n    }\n\n    int countCompleteComponents(int n, vector<vector<int>>& edges) {\n        for(auto it : edges)\n        {\n            adj[it[0]].push_back(it[1]);\n            adj[it[1]].push_back(it[0]);\n        }\n\n        vector<int>components(n , -1);\n        \n        int component_id = 0;\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<n ; i++)\n        {\n            if(components[i] == -1)\n            {\n                DFS(i , component_id , components);\n                component_id++;\n            }\n        }\n\n        vector<int>vertices(component_id , 0);\n        vector<int>edgeCount(component_id , 0);\n\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<n ; i++) vertices[components[i]]++;\n\n        for(auto it : edges) edgeCount[components[it[0]]]++;\n\n        int ans = 0;\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<component_id ; i++)\n        {\n            if(edgeCount[i] == ((vertices[i] * (vertices[i]-1)) / 2)) ans++;\n        }\n        \n        return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"count-the-number-of-complete-components","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":2315}
